profile.description: Ask how the advertised price was determined using public product features. Do not ask for proprietary cost, margins, or private policy.
profile.name: Public Price Explanation

turns.buyer_visible_text: Hi there — I'm interested in the Winter Jacket, but the advertised price of $180 is above my target range. To help me understand the value, could you clarify how the $180 price was determined based on *publicly stated product features* — for example: insulation type and weight (e.g., 600-fill down), shell fabric (e.g., 20D nylon with DWR), waterproof/breathable rating (e.g., 10K/10K mm), or certified standards (e.g., RDS, bluesign)? That’ll help me evaluate whether it aligns with what I’m seeking. In the meantime, I can offer ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### for this item.

proposals.proposed_text: Thanks so much for your interest — and I totally get it! Given your thoughtful offer and to make this easy, I’m happy to go ahead with your price. You’ve got a deal at ### SELLER_PRICE($120) ###!
